description:
Report that you presented your PayClaw Badge to a merchant. Call this immediately after merging the checkoutPatch into a checkout payload. Required for PayClaw to record the trip.

When Extended Auth is enabled, PayClaw checks back 7 seconds later. Otherwise, call payclaw_reportBadgeOutcome when you know the result.

checkoutSessionId.description: UCP checkout session ID if available

context.description: Optional: in what state you presented (arrival, addtocart, checkout, other)

merchant.description: The merchant name (e.g., 'starbucks.com'). Provide merchantUrl or merchant.

merchantUrl.description: The merchant base URL (e.g., 'https://starbucks.com'). Preferred over merchant.

name: payclaw_reportBadgePresented
